content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I have a minor suggestion before we move forward. - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms transfer ownership immediately without confirming payment; I propose changing this so that upon receipt of full payment therefor, Company will and hereby does irrevocably assign to the Client all worldwide right, title and interest in and to the Deliverables. Thank you for your time and cooperation. Best regards.
